mapper.insert: INSERT INTO policy_favorite (user_id, policy_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{policyId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM policy_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND policy_id = #{policyId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, policy_id, created_at FROM policy_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND policy_id = #{policyId} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM policy_favorite f INNER JOIN subsidy_policy p ON p.id = f.policy_id AND p.status = 'ONLINE' WHERE f.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT f.id, f.user_id, f.policy_id, f.created_at, p.title AS title, p.standard AS standard, p.status AS status FROM policy_favorite f INNER JOIN subsidy_policy p ON p.id = f.policy_id AND p.status = 'ONLINE' WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
